text:
nina.design: Quick design poll on the vectors preview export UX. Usability testing: compact density hides row metadata, and the export summary copy is ambiguous (users not sure whether metadata is included). Can we align on copy + behavior?
omar.pm: what's the minimum change to make users confident when exporting?
nina.design: 3 asks: 1) make export labels explicit (CSV vs CSV + metadata), 2) show filename preview including dataset & date, 3) ensure compact mode still exposes full metadata to screenreaders and via tooltip on focus.
lisa.a11y: Accessibility requirements: - Export button needs clear aria-label that includes row count and whether metadata is included (e.g., "Download CSV, 24 rows, with metadata"). - Tooltips must be reachable via keyboard (use aria-describedby). - Compact mode should not rely on hover to reveal truncated metadata; add aria-label or hidden offscreen element with full text.
trent.fe: Implementation notes: can change dropdown items to: "Download CSV (vectors only)", "Download CSV (with metadata)", "Download JSON (vectors + metadata)". Filename pattern: {project}-{dataset}-{YYYYMMDD}-{rows}.csv. I'll add filename preview under the export button.
omar.pm: copy tweak: change visible button to "Download CSV" and put the current selection summary next to it: "CSV · with metadata · 24 rows". That reduces ambiguity without expanding the primary CTA.
nina.design: for compact rows, propose adding a focusable info icon per row that opens a small accessible popover with full metadata and a copy button. The icon should be 44px touch target but visually small.
lisa.a11y: agree. Popover must be focus-trapped while open, have role="dialog", and the copy button inside should have aria-live feedback: "Copied metadata for row v_123". Also ensure popover is keyboard dismissible with ESC.
trent.fe: will prototype popover; note performance: creating many focusable elements could affect large tables. To optimize, render popover content only when opened. Use aria-controls to link the icon to the popover.
nina.design: QA also found the export process isn't announcing completion. We should add a role="status" live region message: "Export ready: redwood-sales-20260322-24.csv" and shift focus to the download link.
lisa.a11y: minor nuance: move focus to the download link after the live region updates, and set aria-atomic so screen readers read the whole message. Throttle progress announcements to avoid spam if streaming.
omar.pm: product decision: default to "with metadata" on export since analytics show >70% include it. Remember user preference in local storage and allow account-level setting later.
trent.fe: will implement defaults + storage. Also will ensure CSV uses RFC4180 quoting and add an advanced option for delimiter (comma/semicolon/tab) because of locale issues.
nina.design: I'll update Figma with the new button copy, summary chip, filename preview, and compact-mode info icon. Can we aim to get a PR up today so a11y can test tomorrow?
trent.fe: yes, opening a branch this afternoon. pinging here when ready.
export-bot: export-smoke-check: csv-quoting -> PASS; a11y-scan -> WARN (popover aria-controls missing in branch).
lisa.a11y: I'll re-check once PR is posted. If aria-controls is added and live region behaviour follows the pattern discussed we're good.
nina.design: thanks team! small win: this should clear up a lot of support tickets about ambiguous exports. :sparkles:
